name: v4.0.525
body:
## What's Changed

- `remotion`: Mute media inside `<Freeze>` by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11299
- `remotion`: Fix media sources in sandboxed iframes by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11285
- `@remotion/studio`: Add skill installation to settings by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11188
- `@remotion/studio`: Add subfolder creation to folder context menu by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11297
- `@remotion/studio`: Add image previews and asset URL replacement by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11303
- `@remotion/studio`: Add keyboard shortcut for Color Picker by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11323
- `@remotion/studio`: Add "Copy context for agents" to folder menus by @sjkim1127 in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11277
- `@remotion/studio`: Open source locations on GitHub in read-only Studio by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11268
- `@remotion/studio`: Show feedback for unsupported Element drops by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11321
- `@remotion/studio`: Make modal tabs responsive by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11304
- `@remotion/studio`: Shorten preview toolbar tooltips by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11267
- `@remotion/studio`: Match sidebar toggle colors with toolbar controls by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11328
- `@remotion/studio`: Save sequence props and keyframes without Prettier by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11308
- `@remotion/studio`: Save effect operations without Prettier by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11317
- `@remotion/studio`: Fix percentage translate values in the Inspector by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11298
- `@remotion/studio`: Fix long computed values overlapping Inspector controls by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11329
- `@remotion/studio`: Fix inspector jumps when selecting effects in inspector by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11313
- `@remotion/studio`: Fix client-side exports ignoring inspector edits by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11306
- `@remotion/studio`: Fix drag commits when pointer capture is lost by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11307
- `@remotion/studio`: Fix left timeline layer double-clicks by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11296
- `@remotion/studio`: Fix preview toolbar tooltip flicker by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11302
- `@remotion/studio`: Fix Element installation undo for new compositions by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11312
- `@remotion/studio`: Restore composition navigation on undo and redo by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11330
- `@remotion/browser-studio`: Import Canvas Captures as compositions by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11322
- [`@remotion/google-fonts`: Add `loadVariableFont()` for variable font axes](https://remotion.dev/docs/google-fonts/load-variable-font) by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11201
- `@remotion/media`: Handle speculative source read failures by @piersonmarks in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11279
- `@remotion/web-renderer`: Fix Remotion-loaded fonts inside SVG text by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11305

## Templates

- `template-empty`: Remove accidental captions element by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11265

## Docs

- Add Animatiq to resources list by @Provibe-dev in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11274
- Add `/remotion-opentimeline` skill by @krishnachitanyapidugu-sys in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/10474

## Elements

- New "Layout" elements by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11253
- Shine effect by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11288
- Tear effect by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11289
- Refine Social Safe Zones by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11290
- Remove Product Offer by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11287

## Internal

- Consolidate effect keyframe Studio test by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11262
- Eliminate recurring CI test races by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11280
- Remove recurrently flaky Studio E2E tests by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11284
- Remove recurring flaky Studio tests by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11286
- Remove Canvas Capture fixture tests by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11301
- Add WebMCP-controlled React Scan recordings by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11316
- remotion.dev/brand: Reorganize compositions by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11264
- remotion.dev/brand: Add Remotion update announcement video by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11271
- remotion.dev/brand: Add Studio UI reference composition by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11272
- remotion.dev/brand: Add responsive Studio UI showcase by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11293
- remotion.dev/brand: Add Codex UI composition by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11310
- remotion.dev/brand: Fix Studio coding handoff window chrome by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11335

## New Contributors

- @krishnachitanyapidugu-sys made their first contribution in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/10474
- @Provibe-dev made their first contribution in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11274
- @sjkim1127 made their first contribution in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11277
- @piersonmarks made their first contribution in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11279

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/compare/v4.0.524...v4.0.525
